_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Microsoft governance day + Mythos goes mainstream day. Microsoft ships a coordinated agent-stack release in a single coordinated drop: Agent Governance Toolkit (first toolkit addressing all 10 OWASP agentic-AI risks, deterministic sub-millisecond p99<0.1ms policy enforcement, seven-package SDK across Python/TypeScript/Rust/Go/.NET, integrations with LangChain/CrewAI/Google ADK/Microsoft Agent Framework + Dify/LlamaIndex/OpenAI Agents SDK/Haystack/LangGraph/PydanticAI, compliance mapped to EU AI Act/HIPAA/SOC 2, 9,500+ tests, foundation handover signalled); Copilot Studio multi-agent systems GA with native A2A protocol — Copilot Studio agents collaborate with LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK; Agent Framework 1.0 GA (production-ready successor to Semantic Kernel + AutoGen, MCP-native auto-discovery, Sequential / Group Chat / Magentic-One orchestration); 41 April updates to M365 Copilot (PowerPoint Agent, Excel Agent, Word Agent variants, hands-free wake word, MCP connector admin gate). Mythos crosses to mainstream: CNN Business publishes the first major-outlet long-form quoting Anthropic's framing that Mythos is 'far ahead of any other AI model in cyber capabilities' and 'presages an upcoming wave of models that can exploit vulnerabilities in ways that far outpace the efforts of defenders'; Anthropic is privately briefing White House and federal-agency officials ahead of the formal 7 April announcement (CETaS syndicates for AISI / DG-CONNECT). The blogosphere reacts in real-time: Thomas Ptacek 'Vulnerability Research Is Cooked' (frontier coding agents are about to step-function exploit dev economics) + three OSS maintainers (Greg Kroah-Hartman, Daniel Stenberg cURL, Willy Tarreau HAProxy) independently confirm the kernel security list has gone from 2-3/week to 5-10/day of real AI-assisted vulnerability reports — Carlini's FreeBSD RCE evidence from Apr 1 now has on-the-ground confirmation from three different upstreams within 48h. MCP Dev Summit NYC closes Day 2 (AAIF governance handover + OAuth profile + registry roadmap); Snowflake medical/health data classifiers GA + Microsoft Power Apps MCP Server + Circle Community MCP. Research wave: SKILL0 (in-context agentic RL with dynamic curriculum — agents internalise tool-use skills during training, operate zero-shot at inference without context overhead of skill libraries), Therefore I Am. I Think (reasoning models encode action/tool-call decisions in pre-generation activations before textual deliberation — chain may be partly post-hoc rationalisation), CORAL (multi-agent persistent memory + asynchronous execution for open-ended discovery beyond debate aggregators), Apriel-Reasoner 15B reproducible RL recipe, Investigating Autonomous Agent Contributions in the Wild (AI coding agents show higher PR activity but elevated churn + lower survival rates vs human code), Ask or Assume? clarification-seeking coding agents, Signals trajectory-sampling triage for agent-observability, The Latent Space position paper, Omni-SimpleMem autoresearch-discovered multimodal agent memory, AutoMIA agentic MIA baselines. Blogs: Willison curates Ptacek + three OSS maintainers + Axios supply-chain social-engineering postmortem; Ingo Eichhorst State of AI Coding Efficiency meta-analysis; Maxime Labonne K2.5 two-weeks-in evaluation. Stage moves: autonomous-cyber-capability surges as Ptacek + three OSS maintainers + CETaS / CNN coverage push fast EMA well above slow; mythos-anthropic surges as CNN crosses Mythos to mainstream; new topic 'agent-governance-runtime' spawns from Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit + ServiceNow Action Fabric + ClawKeeper convergence.
